title: RBAC v2 scenario bank + audit-linked golden regression suite
creator: Priya Rao
description: Build a deterministic, maintainable regression suite for RBAC v2 permission permutations that ties each golden fixture to an audit-log fragment and SSO/SAML event context. The goal is to catch permission regressions and audit mismatches introduced by runtime changes, policy evaluation updates, or deployment-time switchovers (e.g., role-schema migrations). This ticket delivers: (1) a scenario bank of concrete permission matrix cases, (2) golden fixtures that include expected audit log lines and metadata, (3) a replay harness to run deterministic replays and compare audit outputs, and (4) CI gating that fails builds on regression or significant flakiness increases.
acceptance_criteria: A scenario bank with >= 120 deterministic scenarios covering: role inheritance, resource-scoped grants, deny-overrides, and admin escalation paths.

Each scenario must include an accompanying golden fixture containing: expected permission decision, canonical request attributes, and the corresponding audit log snippet (timestamp-agnostic) and SSO/SAML event id.

A replay harness that can consume a golden fixture, replay the policy evaluation path, and assert both decision and audit-log structure match with a configurable tolerance for non-deterministic fields.
CI job (rbac-v2-audit-regress) wired to PRs that runs a fast smoke subset and nightly full-suite; PRs must block merge on new failures unless explicitly approved by security owner.
Dashboard that surfaces regression counts, flaky scenario score, and latest failing fixture with links to logs and the failing PR.
Documentation page with guidelines for adding new scenarios and maintaining golden audit snippets (Confluence link included in artifacts).
test_plan: Phase 1: Author scenario bank (conservative coverage) and 20 initial golden fixtures focusing on most-critical admin/data-plane paths.
Phase 2: Implement deterministic replay harness (Go/pytest wrapper) that runs inside a hermetic test image and records full evaluation trace.
Phase 3: Extend harness to correlate SSO/SAML event metadata and simulate session/context attributes fed to policy engine.
Phase 4: Implement mutation-based fuzz generator that creates small variations of existing fixtures to find brittle comparisons and surface audit-log schema drift.
Phase 5: CI integration: fast-smoke on PRs (~30 scenarios), nightly full run (~120+ scenarios); alerting to #rbac-regressions Slack with failure summary.
Phase 6: Add flakiness scoring and automatic quarantine for historically unstable scenarios (with manual review path).
artifacts: CI Job: rbac-v2-audit-regress (Jenkins/Buildkite config in repo/tests/ci)
updates: 2025-03-12: Kickoff sync with Security, Auth, and Platform teams. Agreed core scope and acceptance criteria. Action: Priya to draft scenario taxonomy.

2025-03-18: Design review with Policy team. Decided to canonicalize audit snippets by removing timestamps and session ids; include SSO event id as stable reference. Action: Alex to prototype canonicalizer.
2025-03-22: Prototype harness committed in feature/eng/ENG-13240/harness-proto. PR opened: #1864. Basic replay works for simple allow/deny flows.
2025-03-28: Security requested inclusion of SAML assertion attributes for 3 scenarios to validate identity mapping logic. Added to Phase 3 scope.
2025-04-01: First 20 golden fixtures added to gs://redwood-fixtures/rbac-v2. Nightly job configured but not yet blocking PRs.

2025-04-02: Flakiness detection plan drafted. Proposal: run last 30 nightly results, compute per-scenario instability score, surface top 10 flaky scenarios to owners. Blocker: need storage of historical pass/fail; dependence ENG-12780 (test-results-retention).
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Golden fixtures may be brittle to unrelated runtime noise (timestamp, ordering). Mitigation: canonicalizer that strips non-deterministic fields and a tolerant diff with field-level matchers.
Risk: Test suite runtime could be slow and increase CI costs. Mitigation: stratify scenarios into smoke and full-suite; use CI caching and dedicated nightly runners on Dedicated capacity.
Risk: Missing real-world coverage for edge cases. Mitigation: fuzz generator seeded from production audit logs (anonymized) and prioritized addition back to scenario bank.
Risk: Owner drift over time; nobody maintains fixtures. Mitigation: add rubric to docs and require a test-case for each RBAC schema change as part of the PR checklist.
Risk: Sensitive data in fixtures. Mitigation: enforce storage in encrypted buckets and review of any fixture that references production ids; security_review_required = true.
Risk: Correlation with SSO/SAML events requires auth team alignment. Mitigation: weekly sync until Phase 3 complete and one joint code review with Auth owners.
